translations.web: I will be like the dew to Israel. He will blossom like the lily, and send down his roots like Lebanon.
translations.bsb: I will be like the dew to Israel; he will blossom like the lily and take root like the cedars of Lebanon.
translations.kjv: I will be as the dew unto Israel: he shall grow as the lily, and cast forth his roots as Lebanon.
